noise_diagnostic.summary_text:
DIAGNOSTIC MULTI-FLUX - Analyse sur 6 flux

Score moyen de proxy de variance: 0.750 (échelle 0-1)
Score maximum: 0.750, Score minimum: 0.750

TOP 3 FLUX AVEC SIGNATURE CSD:
  1. fliprate (score: 0.750)
     - Q5 ratio: 28.60 vs bruit blanc 0.02
     - Hurst max: 1.117, Pente FFT: -0.607
  2. flip (score: 0.750)
     - Q5 ratio: 28.60 vs bruit blanc 0.02
     - Hurst max: 1.117, Pente FFT: -0.607
  3. energy (score: 0.750)
     - Q5 ratio: 20.15 vs bruit blanc 0.02
     - Hurst max: 1.019, Pente FFT: -0.669

BOTTOM 3 FLUX (BRUIT BLANC):
  1. magnetization (score: 0.750)
     - Hurst moyen: 0.908
  2. localvar (score: 0.750)
     - Hurst moyen: 0.966
  3. susceptibility (score: 0.750)
     - Hurst moyen: 0.917
